post.description: To price one SKU (plan) across regions, or one region's deployment, by id from `records_list`, `search` or an IBM catalog URL.

countries.description: Keep only `amounts[].country` codes listed (as published: `USA`, `GBR`, `EURO`, ...). Default: all 29.

deployment_id.description: Optional deployment id from a previous record of this plan: `{plan_id}:{region}{suffix}` for regional plans (e.g. `04991f9d-562f-4293-a178-86cab5fccb68:us-south97469`) or the global slug (e.g. `pro-deployment-global-64594477`). Rows are labelled with `plan_id`; pass a deployment that belongs to it. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$.

metrics.description: Keep only metrics whose `metric_id` or `charge_unit_name` is listed (case-insensitive), e.g. `["INSTANCE_HOURS_MULTI_TENANT"]`. Default: all metrics.

plan_id.description: Catalog plan id: UUID (`04991f9d-562f-4293-a178-86cab5fccb68`) or dotted slug (`containers.kubernetes.baremetal.16x128.gpu`). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$.

regions.description: Keep only deployments whose `deployment_region` is listed (case-insensitive), e.g. `["us-south"]`. Default: all regions.

200.description:
One plan's price sheet by the site's own plan id: `GET /api/v1/{plan_id}?complete=true` (404 -> not_found; a non-plan entry -> not_found), then `GET /api/v1/{plan_id}/pricing/deployment` (all pages) or, with `deployment_id`, `GET /api/v1/{deployment_id}/pricing`. Plans without regional deployments fall back to the global `GET /api/v1/{plan_id}/pricing` row (`deployment_id` null). VPC `is.*` plans are joined to the `*.profile` entry named like the plan (vCPU, memory, tenancy). Records are flattened like `records_list`. Collection contract name: `records/get`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `deployment_id` | string | Echo of the requested deployment id, null when the whole plan was priced. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Observation time (ms since epoch) stamped by the SDK. |
| `plan` | object |  |
| `publication_id` | string | Listing ETag at the time of the call. |
| `record_count` | number |  |
| `records` | object[] |  |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description: To collect the whole price panel (or one service's) page by page. Use `records_get` for one plan.

continuation.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page. Not with `entry_id` or `kinds`.

countries.description: Keep only `amounts[].country` codes listed (as published: `USA`, `GBR`, `EURO`, ...). Default: all 29.

entry_id.description: Restrict the walk to one catalog entry (segment), e.g. `is.instance` or `containers-kubernetes`. Not with `continuation`. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$.

kinds.description: Entry kinds to walk, in this order. Default `service, iaas, platform_service, composite`. Not with `continuation` or `entry_id`.

metrics.description: Keep only metrics whose `metric_id` or `charge_unit_name` is listed (case-insensitive), e.g. `["INSTANCE_HOURS_MULTI_TENANT"]`. Default: all metrics.

plans_per_page.description:
Plans priced per page (1..5, default 2). A VPC plan with 13 regions yields ~9,600 records unfiltered.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 5; default 2.

regions.description: Keep only deployments whose `deployment_region` is listed (case-insensitive), e.g. `["us-south"]`. Default: all regions.

200.description:
Full current list of IBM Cloud list prices, one record per plan x deployment (region) x metric x country x quantity tier, walked in catalog order: `GET /api/v1?q=kind:<kind>&_limit=200&_offset=N` (service, iaas, platform_service, composite by default), then `GET /api/v1/{entry}/plan`, then for each plan tagged `paid` `GET /api/v1/{plan}/pricing/deployment` (all pages of 50). The cursor pins the listing ETag and the newest pricing `effective_from` seen; a page that finds a different ETag or a newer `effective_from` fails with `invalid_input` code `publication_changed` instead of mixing versions. Segment key: `entry_id` restricts the walk to one catalog entry. Each page prices at most `plans_per_page` plans and examines at most 20 entries. VPC plans are joined to their `*.profile` entry (vCPU, memory, tenancy). Filters (`regions`, `countries`, `metrics`, `plans_per_page`) are not stored in the cursor: pass them again with `continuation`. Collection contract name: `records/list`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `effective_from` | string | Newest deployment `effective_from` seen so far in the walk; null when no deployment has been priced yet. |
| `entries_examined` | number | Catalog entries visited on this page (including those without paid plans). |
| `entry_id` | string | The segment entry id when the walk is restricted; null for the kind walk. |
| `kinds` | string[] | Kinds walked (empty for an `entry_id` segment). |
| `next_cursor` | string | Opaque cursor for the next page; null when the walk is exhausted. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Observation time (ms since epoch) stamped by the SDK. |
| `plan_count` | number |  |
| `plans` | object[] | Plans priced on this page, in catalog order. |
| `publication_id` | string | Listing ETag pinned by this walk. |
| `record_count` | number |  |
| `records` | object[] | Flattened price rows for the plans on this page. |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Cheap version check of the IBM Cloud Global Catalog: the listing ETag (`GET /api/v1?_limit=1`) as `publication_id`, the top-level entry count, and the pricing `effective_from`/`effective_until` of the sentinel VPC plan `bx3d-2x10` (`GET /api/v1/{plan}/pricing/deployment?_limit=1`). IBM posts no content hash and no total record count; `content_hash` and `record_count` are null. No delta endpoint exists, so `records/changes` is not offered. Collection contract name: `source/status`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content_hash` | object | Always null: the publisher posts no hash; use `publication_id` and `effective_from`. |
| `effective_from` | string | Deployment pricing `effective_from` of the sentinel plan (e.g. `2026-10-01T00:00:00Z`): the price-list publication date. |
| `effective_until` | string | Deployment pricing `effective_until` of the sentinel plan. |
| `entry_count` | number | `count` of top-level catalog entries (1085 on 2026-10-18). |
| `files` | object[] | Publisher URLs: the paged listing and the OpenAPI document. No bulk file exists. |
| `listing_etag` | string | The ETag header verbatim. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Observation time (ms since epoch) stamped by the SDK. |
| `publication_id` | string | Listing ETag without quotes/weak marker, e.g. `13926222757257854238-162029,9202038589444147662-6`; identical across listing, search and kind-filter calls at one catalog revision. |
| `published_at` | string | Same as `effective_from` (the contract's published_at). |
| `record_count` | object | Always null: a full census needs ~1,500 pricing calls. |
| `retrieved_at` | string |  |
| `segment_key` | string | How `records_list` segments the collection: `entry` (one service-like catalog entry, walked in listing order). |
| `sentinel_deployment_count` | number | Priced deployments (regions) of the sentinel plan (13 on 2026-10-18). |
| `sentinel_plan_id` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
